div.head: III Eg 5
div.ab: ⁊ sece man hundredgemót, swa hit ǽr geset wæs.
⁊ sece mon hundredgemót, swa hit ær geset wæs.
⁊ sece man hundredes gemot, swa hit ǽr geset wæs.
⁊ sece man hundredes gemot, swa hit ær geset wæs.
Et requiratur hundretum, sicut antea fuit institutum.
[Be gemotum.] ⁊ sece man hundredes gemot swa hit ǽr geset wæs.
And sece man hundredgemot, swa hit ær geset wæs.
(Von Gerichtsversammlungen. Ld) Und man besuche das Hundertgericht, wie es zuvor festgesetzt worden ist.
(Of court-meetings. Ld) And let the hundred-court be attended, as was established before.
And the hundred court shall be attended as has been previously ordained.
And the hundred court is to be attended as it was previously established.
And the hundred court is to be attended, just as has been previously established.
